verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs give concrete recall figures (>90% recall, an index auto-tuned for 90–100% recall) and offer a recall endpoint so users can measure recall on their own data. Latency is only described qualitatively ("low-latency queries to petabyte scale", "fast"), and a community commenter notes the introductory page contains substantial performance data. Commenters disputed that page's ClickHouse comparison figures, but those concern a competitor, not turbopuffer's own numbers. Missing for 10: published latency numbers (p50/p99) or a benchmark methodology in the evidence, independent benchmark corroboration, and throughput figures.
